// diagnostic

E0909

Calling `{function}` through `{instance}` here needs a deeper instance every time, so building it never ends

What

Calling `{function}` through `{instance}` here needs a deeper instance every time, so building it never ends

Why

Each instance of a generic function is built for its own types, and this call leads back to it with its type nested one level deeper

Fix

Simplify the generic nesting or split the instantiation into smaller bounds.

Worked example

First UI snapshot mentioning E0909: tests/ui/E0909_expanding_generic_instance.stderr.

Error [jet.InstantiationTooDeep]: Calling `deeper` through `Grow<[T]>` here needs a deeper instance every time, so building it never ends

    |                ^^^^^^
 Why: Each instance of a generic function is built for its own types, and this call leads back to it with its type nested one level deeper
 Fix: Simplify the generic nesting or split the instantiation into smaller bounds.
